text:
𝗗𝗘𝗖𝗜𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝗗𝗔𝗬! 🇮🇳

India lead NZ 2-1; the 5th ODI at Bay Oval starts 7:30 AM IST Sunday.
One win = first ODI series win in NZ since 2018-19.

Will India finish it? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦 𝗞𝗔 𝗙𝗜𝗡𝗔𝗟𝗟𝗬 𝗗𝗘𝗖𝗜𝗗𝗘𝗥! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 India 2-1 se aage, Bay Oval mein 5th ODI kal subah 7:30 AM IST se
👉 Ek jeet aur New Zealand mein 2018-19 ke baad pehli ODI series jeet
👉 Bay Oval par ODI mein pehli pari ka average score 273 raha hai

Kya India series pakad legi? Comment karo 👇
